title: Korean remittance firm Inainpay reportedly lost 약 25억원 in hacking; FSS sends on-site inspectors
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day, 27 November; it says the Financial Supervisory Service sent the inspection team that day.
geo_basis: country: the article names no city for the company
summary: Herald Business reports that Inainpay, a small cross-border remittance company, was hacked repeatedly and 약 25억원 was taken, according to the report. The article says the exact damage is not yet confirmed and financial authorities are assessing it. It says the Financial Supervisory Service sent an on-site inspection team on 27 November. The article carries no statement from the company.
plain: Herald Business reports that a Korean remittance company lost 약 25억원 to hackers. The financial regulator has sent inspectors; the exact damage is not confirmed.
exec: Herald Business reports 약 25억원 taken from a remittance firm and a regulator on-site inspection; the exact damage is unconfirmed.
